title: Best Book Trailer Creators (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a book trailer creator: what the package should include, formats for social media, rights, price factors and red flags.
intro: A book trailer is a short video that promotes a book, like a movie trailer. It is used on social media, author websites, ads and bookstore pages. Good trailers capture the mood and hook of the book in seconds. They go wrong when they reveal too much, use unlicensed images or music, or are made only in formats that do not suit social platforms. This guide helps authors order trailers that reach readers.

faq.q: How long should a book trailer be?
faq.a: Short. Many effective trailers are well under a minute. Social media versions can be even shorter.

faq.q: What goes into a book trailer?
faq.a: The book's hook, mood, a few key images, the cover, the author name and where to buy. Avoid spoilers.

faq.q: Can I use images from the internet?
faq.a: Only licensed images, footage and music. Book trailers are promotional, so commercial licenses are needed.
